objective: Reusable batch branch recovery, authenticated physical-ROM dependency graph, optional independent sampled parity comparison, and unified game progress in both Workbench discovery and native pages

tests.method: segmented unittest suites; PYTHONPATH=tests:. for legacy test helpers

verified: two independent synthetic Master System fixtures follow the generic native fixed-vector recovery path
physical bank and fixed ROM addresses remain separated and original ROM hashes authenticate graph nodes
new native-progress endpoint preserves per-game native pilot evidence even when legacy conversion-v031 rows are absent
bounded Ghidra branch prefetch accepts only source-attested evidence and does not guess indirect branches
optional external reference comparison reports mismatched sampled CPU fields and does not synthesize independent reference evidence
migration includes immediate prior working catalogue and preserves older installation evidence references
all regressions and bridge suites pass under segmented runner
not_verified: real second commercial Master System game native execution (owner ROM not supplied)
independent Shinobi or other commercial game CPU and hardware parity
playable native Shinobi or verified frame
native 68000/MIPS execution via integrated common backend
note: Only source metadata/catalogue and tools are distributed. All original ROMs remain user-local.
